_comment: Each scenario: level (which parts and materials are unlocked, and the build points: unlocks.json), budget (credits for the whole ship), allow (catalogue categories it may use; default all), the hits it takes (incoming: damage a hit, its pen and type, damage per second, where from: front, rear, sides, left, right or all, and the spread in degrees), and how it is scored (weights: each measure against the starting ship's, so 1 = as good as the start; penalties: per part). Measures: damage_before_down, alive_s, half_s, sustained_dps, burst_dps, thrust_to_mass, cargo. Penalties: unpowered (guns, engines, shields under a quarter of their power), idle (relays and reactors nothing goes through), parts.

scenarios.name: Gunship: head-on fight
scenarios.about: Fights facing the enemy: most hits come at the nose. Scored on damage dealt before going down.

scenarios.name: Brawler: surrounded
scenarios.about: Hit from every side. Survival matters as much as damage.

scenarios.name: Hauler: get the cargo home
scenarios.about: Carries as much as it can, fast, and survives being chased (hits from behind).
